title: Regression: the work order pick Available chip still counts only positive bins for a part with a negative bin
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Reports View. Data: QAPL-N1 (tracked, active, bins +5 and -2) at Staging Heavy Duty; an open work order at Staging Heavy Duty. Known mismatch (intended, don't file): WO availability, the Supply filter and Parts Velocity keep the positive-bins rule, so they differ from Inventory Value.
custom_steps:
1. Parts > Inventory > search "QAPL-N1"; open it and note its bins, Min and Max; Cancel.
  2. On the open work order: Add Part > type "QAPL-N1".
  3. Reports > Inventory Value (/reports/inventory-value): Staging Heavy Duty, As-of today > Run; find QAPL-N1.
  4. Parts > Inventory > Supply filter: pick each level in turn (Under-supplied, Well-supplied, Over-supplied, All) and note where QAPL-N1 appears.
  5. Close the Add Part lookup on the work order without adding the part.
custom_expected:
1. Bins +5 and -2; the row's quantity cell shows the available 5 (positive bins).
  2. The QAPL-N1 option shows the chip "5 available", not 3.
  3. QAPL-N1 shows Qty 3 (the net of its bins).
  4. QAPL-N1 is classed by its positive-bin quantity 5 against its Min and Max, not by the net 3; it is listed under All.
  5. Nothing is added to the work order.
